1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Na5 4.b4.strategy: Strikes at the displaced knight at once: the pawn attacks both the knight and the c5 pawn, offering a pawn to harass a piece that stands badly. The gambit costs material if Black simply takes it and defends calmly.
1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Na5 4.b4.name: Sicilian Defence: Nyezhmetdinov-Rossolimo Attack, San Francisco Gambit
